exposure: antiretroviral therapy (ART) class (non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI)-based, integrase strand-transfer inhibitor (INSTI)-based, protease inhibitor (PI)-based regimens)
cohort: The study analyzed placentas from 79 pregnant people living with HIV (PPLWH) stratified by ART class and 29 HIV-uninfected people.
finding: Placentas of pregnant people living with HIV (PPLWH) on any ART regimen displayed significantly more leukocytes and Hofbauer cells, with a selection for CD163+ cells compared to HIV-negative controls, regardless of the specific class of ART.
